title: Part 7 — Single passage 8: press release
instructionsVi: Thông cáo báo chí, bốn câu hỏi. Có một câu chèn câu và một câu hỏi từ vựng theo ngữ cảnh — hai dạng khó nhất của Part 7.
promptEn: Refer to the following press release and answer the questions.
passage:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Riverside Print acquires Bellamy Bindery

FAIRPORT, 3 May — Riverside Print has today announced the acquisition of Bellamy Bindery, a family-owned finishing business operating in the region since 1962.

— [1] — The two companies have worked together for over a decade, with Riverside routinely sending its hardback work to Bellamy for binding. Bringing the operation in-house is expected to cut turnaround on those jobs from nine working days to four.

— [2] — All eighteen Bellamy staff will transfer on their existing terms, and the Bellamy site on Wren Street will continue to operate for at least two years. Managing Director Ines Duarte said the company had no plans to consolidate the two sites.

'This is not a cost exercise,' Ms Duarte said. — [3] — 'We bought a capability we were already paying for, and a team that knows how to use it.'

Bellamy's founder, Harold Bellamy, retired in 2019. The business has since been run by his daughter, who will remain as production manager. — [4] —

questions.prompt: 166. What is the purpose of the press release?

options.text: To announce an acquisition
To advertise a new binding service
To announce a site closure
To report annual results

questions.explanationVi: 'has today announced the acquisition of Bellamy Bindery'.

questions.prompt: 167. What benefit is expected from the deal?

options.text: A reduction in staff numbers
The closure of the Wren Street site
Lower paper prices
Faster turnaround on hardback work

questions.explanationVi: 'cut turnaround on those jobs from nine working days to four'. (A) và (B) đều bị bài bác bỏ trực tiếp.

questions.prompt: 168. The word 'capability' in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to

options.text: a legal right
a technical ability the company can now use
a financial reserve
a customer list

questions.explanationVi: 'We bought a capability we were already paying for' — nghĩa là năng lực đóng sách mà trước đây họ phải thuê ngoài. Câu tiếp theo nói rõ 'a team that knows how to use it'.

questions.prompt:
169. In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3] and [4] does the following sentence best belong?

'The two businesses are therefore already familiar with each other's standards.'
questions.explanationVi: Từ 'therefore' đòi hỏi câu trước phải nêu lý do. Đoạn ngay trước [2] nói hai bên đã hợp tác hơn một thập kỷ — đó chính là lý do.

title: Part 7 — Single passage 9: memo with schedule
instructionsVi: Bản ghi nhớ kèm lịch. Câu hỏi buộc đối chiếu phần chữ với phần lịch — đọc lướt một trong hai là sai.
promptEn: Refer to the following memo and answer the questions.
passage:
MEMORANDUM
To: Production team
From: Shift Planning
Subject: Maintenance week, 8–12 July

Each line will be taken out of service for one day during maintenance week. The schedule below shows which line is down on which day.

Mon 8 — Line 1
Tue 9 — Line 2
Wed 10 — Line 3
Thu 11 — Line 4
Fri 12 — no line down; contingency day

Staff whose line is out of service should report to the line immediately after theirs in the sequence — so Line 1 staff work Line 2 on Monday, and so on. Line 4 staff report to Line 1.

Friday is held in reserve. If any line's maintenance overruns, that line will be completed on Friday and the affected staff will be notified the previous afternoon. If all work finishes on schedule, Friday runs as a normal production day on all four lines.

questions.prompt: 170. Where should Line 3 staff work on Wednesday?

options.text: Line 1
Line 4
Line 2
They do not work that day.

questions.explanationVi: Line 3 nghỉ vào thứ Tư, và quy tắc là báo cáo sang dây chuyền KẾ TIẾP trong dãy — tức Line 4. Phải ghép quy tắc với lịch.

questions.prompt: 171. What is the purpose of Friday?

options.text: It is a training day.
All four lines are down.
It is a public holiday.
It is held in reserve for overrunning work.

questions.explanationVi: 'Friday is held in reserve. If any line's maintenance overruns, that line will be completed on Friday'.

questions.prompt: 172. How will staff learn that they are needed on Friday?

options.text: They will be told on Friday morning.
A notice will be posted on Monday.
They will be notified the previous afternoon.
They must check the schedule themselves.

questions.explanationVi: 'the affected staff will be notified the previous afternoon'.

title: Part 7 — Single passage 10: policy extract
instructionsVi: Trích quy định. Câu hỏi buộc ÁP DỤNG quy định vào một tình huống cụ thể, không chỉ tìm lại thông tin.
promptEn: Refer to the following policy extract and answer the questions.
passage:
HALCYON INSURANCE — Travel cover, section 4: cancellation

4.1 Cover applies where a trip is cancelled for a reason listed in 4.2, and where the trip was booked at least fourteen days before departure.

4.2 Listed reasons: illness or injury of the policyholder or an immediate family member; jury service; redundancy notified after the booking date; and cancellation of the outbound service by the carrier.

4.3 Claims must be submitted within twenty-eight days of the cancellation, with the original booking confirmation and evidence of the reason.

4.4 Where the carrier cancels the outbound service, the policyholder must first seek a refund from the carrier. This policy covers only the amount the carrier does not refund.

4.5 Cover does not apply where the policyholder cancels because of a change in work commitments other than redundancy, or because of a change of mind.

questions.prompt: 173. A policyholder cancels because her employer has moved a project deadline. Is she covered?

options.text: Yes, work commitments are a listed reason.
No, only redundancy is covered among work reasons.
Yes, provided she claims within 28 days.
Only if the trip was booked more than 14 days ahead.

questions.explanationVi: 4.5 loại trừ rõ 'a change in work commitments other than redundancy'. Phải áp dụng điều khoản loại trừ, không chỉ đọc danh sách 4.2.

questions.prompt: 174. What must a policyholder do first if the airline cancels the outbound flight?

options.text: Submit a claim to the insurer immediately
Rebook the same flight
Seek a refund from the airline
Obtain a letter from the airline

questions.explanationVi: 4.4: 'the policyholder must first seek a refund from the carrier'. Bảo hiểm chỉ chi phần hãng không hoàn.

questions.prompt: 175. What is required alongside the claim?

options.text: The original booking confirmation and evidence of the reason
A police report
Proof of payment of the premium
A signed statement from the employer

questions.explanationVi: 4.3: 'with the original booking confirmation and evidence of the reason'.

title: Part 7 — Double passage 1: email and invoice
instructionsVi: Bộ hai văn bản, 5 câu. Ít nhất hai câu chỉ trả lời được khi GHÉP thông tin từ cả hai văn bản — đó là câu quyết định điểm Part 7.
promptEn: Refer to the following email and invoice, then answer the questions.
passage:
EMAIL
From: d.tran@brightleaf.example
To: accounts@merridewsupplies.example
Date: 3 May
Subject: Invoice 44219 — query

Dear Accounts team,

I am writing about invoice 44219, received yesterday. Two items do not match our purchase order PO-8871.

First, we ordered 40 boxes of A4 paper, not 60. Second, the delivery charge of $45 was waived when we placed the order, as our total exceeded the $500 threshold for free delivery.

Could you issue a corrected invoice? We will pay within seven days of receiving it, as usual.

Regards,
Dinh Tran, Office Manager

---

INVOICE 44219 — Merridew Supplies
Date: 1 May · Customer: Brightleaf Ltd · Ref: PO-8871

A4 paper, 60 boxes @ $9.00 ......... $540.00
Black ink cartridges, 12 @ $22.00 ... $264.00
Desk lamps, 4 @ $31.00 ............. $124.00
Delivery charge ..................... $45.00
TOTAL .............................. $973.00

Payment terms: 30 days from invoice date.

questions.prompt: 176. Why did Mr Tran write the email?

options.text: To place a new order
To request a delivery date
To report errors on an invoice
To cancel a purchase order

questions.explanationVi: 'Two items do not match our purchase order'. Câu hỏi mục đích luôn nằm ở đoạn đầu email.

questions.prompt: 177. How many boxes of A4 paper should have been invoiced?

options.text: The email does not say.

questions.explanationVi: 'we ordered 40 boxes of A4 paper, not 60'. Hoá đơn ghi 60 — đó là chỗ sai.

questions.prompt: 178. What will the corrected total be, once both errors are fixed?
questions.explanationVi: Giấy đúng là 40 × $9 = $360, giảm $180; bỏ phí giao hàng $45. $973 − $180 − $45 = $748. Bắt buộc ghép hai văn bản.

questions.prompt: 179. Why does Mr Tran believe delivery should be free?

options.text: Because the goods arrived late
Because the order exceeded $500
Because delivery is always free for regular customers
Because he collected the goods himself

questions.explanationVi: 'our total exceeded the $500 threshold for free delivery'.

questions.prompt: 180. What is suggested about the payment schedule?

options.text: Brightleaf will pay 30 days after the original invoice date.
Merridew has refused to change the terms.
Brightleaf intends to pay faster than the stated terms.
Payment has already been made in full.

questions.explanationVi: Hoá đơn ghi 30 ngày, nhưng email nói sẽ trả 'within seven days of receiving' hoá đơn sửa. Ghép hai chi tiết mới ra hàm ý.

title: Part 7 — Double passage 2: advertisement and email
instructionsVi: Bộ hai văn bản, 5 câu. Có một câu tính toán dựa trên điều kiện nằm ở văn bản thứ nhất và dữ kiện nằm ở văn bản thứ hai.
promptEn: Refer to the following advertisement and email, then answer the questions.
passage:
ADVERTISEMENT
HARBOURSIDE SELF-STORAGE — Fairport

Unit sizes and monthly rates:
Small (25 sq ft) — $48
Medium (50 sq ft) — $79
Large (100 sq ft) — $135
Extra large (200 sq ft) — $240

· First month half price for new customers.
· 10% discount on any unit booked for six months or more, applied from month two onwards.
· 24-hour access included. Insurance is not included and must be arranged separately.
· Units may be changed once during a contract at no charge.

---

EMAIL
From: r.beck@example.com
To: enquiries@harboursidestorage.example
Date: 12 August
Subject: Unit enquiry

Hello,

I am moving out of my flat next month and need storage for eight months while I am working abroad.

I have measured what I need to store and it comes to roughly 90 square feet, so I assume the large unit is right, though I would rather not pay for space I do not use.

Two questions. First, do I need to arrange my own insurance, or is it included? Second, if my plans change and I return earlier than expected, can I move to a smaller unit partway through?

Regards,
Rowan Beck

questions.prompt: 181. Which unit is most suitable for Mr Beck?

options.text: Small
Medium
Large
Extra large

questions.explanationVi: Ông ta cần khoảng 90 sq ft; Medium chỉ 50, nên phải lên Large (100). Ghép số đo trong email với bảng giá.

questions.prompt: 182. Will Mr Beck qualify for the six-month discount?

options.text: No, the discount applies only to small units.
No, he must pay for twelve months.
Only if he pays in advance.
Yes, because he needs eight months.

questions.explanationVi: '10% discount on any unit booked for six months or more' — ông ta cần tám tháng nên đủ điều kiện.

questions.prompt: 183. How much will Mr Beck pay for his first month?
questions.explanationVi: Large là $135, tháng đầu nửa giá = $67,50. Mức giảm 10% chỉ áp dụng 'from month two onwards', nên không cộng dồn ở tháng đầu — đây là bẫy chính.

questions.prompt: 184. What is the answer to Mr Beck's first question?

options.text: He must arrange insurance separately.
Insurance is included in the rate.
Insurance is optional for long contracts.
The advertisement does not say.

questions.explanationVi: 'Insurance is not included and must be arranged separately'.

questions.prompt: 185. What is the answer to Mr Beck's second question?

options.text: He may change unit once at no charge.
Changes are not permitted mid-contract.
A fee applies to any change.
He must sign a new contract.

questions.explanationVi: 'Units may be changed once during a contract at no charge'.
